convertibility_reason: Uses JBrainTrend1 custom indicator (iCustom), which has no built-in MT5 equivalent. ReOpen logic implies position management beyond simple entry/exit. Custom indicator dependency requires Python reimplementation of the JBrainTrend1 indicator algorithm.

other_exits: ReOpen logic: closes position on signal reversal, then may re-enter on next valid signal

custom_logic_notes: ReOpen feature: after a stop-loss hit or signal reversal close, the EA may re-enter the same direction if the JBrainTrend1 signal remains valid. JBrainTrend1 is a trend-following custom indicator that generates buy/sell signals based on color changes (typically blue for bullish, red for bearish). The 'Stop' variant uses the indicator's built-in stop level for SL placement rather than a fixed pip value. Exact indicator algorithm must be obtained from JBrainTrend1 source code for Python conversion.
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer or obtain JBrainTrend1 indicator source to reimplement in Python. The indicator likely uses a combination of moving averages and ATR-based volatility for signal generation. ReOpen logic adds complexity: track closed-by-stop trades and re-entry conditions. Digit adjustment logic for 5-digit brokers must be handled. The stop level from JBrainTrend1 is dynamic and indicator-computed, not a simple pip offset.
